info.title: Google Ads
info.description: Read-only access to Google Ads API campaigns, ad groups, ads and their performance. Get an access token first, then pass it to the other actions.

post.description: Exchanges the Google OAuth client ID, client secret and refresh token for an access token (valid for one hour). Pass it as 'Access token' to the other actions.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token issued for the adwords scope.

get.description: Lists the customer IDs the Google user behind the access token can open directly.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Google OAuth access token from the 'Get access token' action (valid for one hour).

parameters.name: developer-token
parameters.description: Google Ads API developer token (Google Ads > Tools > API Center).

get.description: Lists the accounts under a customer. For a manager (MCC) this is its client accounts; for a regular account it is the account itself.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Google Ads customer (account) ID, 10 digits. Dashes are allowed.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Google OAuth access token from the 'Get access token' action (valid for one hour).

parameters.name: developer-token
parameters.description: Google Ads API developer token (Google Ads > Tools > API Center).

parameters.name: login-customer-id
parameters.description: Manager (MCC) account ID to access the customer through. Required when the signed-in user reaches the account via a manager account.

parameters.name: include_managers
parameters.description: Also return manager accounts.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Also return hidden accounts.

parameters.name: include_all_levels
parameters.description: Return the whole tree, not just direct children.
